scope: Proposition 8 of the manuscript “Integer multiplication below n log n” (preprints/Integer-multiplication-below-n-log-n-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 109 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 834f644c3ce67932), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 18-19. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For each edge of the complex network, write U, V for its tail and head labels. Its phase-frame difference CV C−1 U is a product of one translation kernel aI + bXv, or its inverse, per vector in an orthonormal basis of the edge residual. Here (Xvf)(x) = f(x + v). The sum of these basis lengths is sc = Wcm − 2N + 2Lc = 1873807244636671267308000000 < Wcm. 18 After source and sink diagonal corrections, and undoing the signed bank exchange, telescoping these phase frames gives C⊗m on every role, including auxiliary roles. The same assertion holds on any positive number of columns by taking tensor products over columns.
